---
kind: mdbase.type
name: tasknotes-settings
version: 1
description: TaskNotes' collection-wide settings, one record at _settings/dev.tasknotes.md.
match:
  where:
    app:
      eq: dev.tasknotes
schema:
  dialect: json-schema-2020-12
  value:
    $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
    title: tasknotes.settings 1.0.0
    description: Collection-wide behaviour that every TaskNotes client honours. Every field is optional and has a default, so a record with none of them behaves like no record at all.
    type: object
    required:
      - app
      - scope
      - settings_version
    properties:
      app:
        const: dev.tasknotes
        description: Marks this record as TaskNotes' settings.
      scope:
        const: collection
        description: These settings apply to everyone using TaskNotes in this collection.
      settings_version:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        description: The version of these settings that last wrote the record. TaskNotes writes 1.
      nlp_triggers:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - property_id
            - trigger
            - enabled
          properties:
            property_id:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
            trigger:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
            enabled:
              type: boolean
          additionalProperties: false
        description: Natural-language capture triggers, such as @ for contexts. Without the field each client uses its own defaults.
      template_enabled:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Apply template_path to the body of new tasks.
      template_path:
        type: string
        description: The template for new task bodies. Empty or absent means none.
      occurrence_template_enabled:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Apply occurrence_template_path to new materialized occurrences.
      occurrence_template_path:
        type: string
        description: The template for new occurrence bodies. Empty or absent means none.
      template_failure_mode:
        enum:
          - error
          - warning_fallback
        description: What a client does when a template cannot be applied.
      template_unknown_variable_policy:
        enum:
          - preserve
          - empty
        description: What a client writes for a template variable it does not know.
      move_on_archive:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Move a task's file to archive_folder when it is archived.
      archive_folder:
        type: string
        description: Where archived tasks move to. Empty or absent means the client's default.
      auto_stop_time_tracking_on_complete:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Stop a running timer when its task is completed.
      reset_body_checkboxes_on_recurrence:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Uncheck body checkboxes when a recurring task moves to its next occurrence.
      link_write_format:
        enum:
          - wikilink
          - markdown
        default: wikilink
        description: How clients write links into task frontmatter. Both formats are always read.
      status_behavior:
        type: object
        description: Behaviour per status value. A status without an entry has no next status and no auto-archive, and is out of the status cycle exactly when it is a skipped status.
        additionalProperties:
          type: object
          properties:
            next_status:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
              description: The status the cycle moves to next.
            exclude_from_cycle:
              type: boolean
              description: Leave this status out of the status cycle.
            auto_archive:
              type: boolean
              description: Archive a task some time after it takes this status.
            auto_archive_delay_minutes:
              type: number
              minimum: 0
              description: How long after taking this status a task is archived.
          additionalProperties: false
        default: {}
    additionalProperties: true
collection:
  unique:
    - field: app
      scope: type
implements:
  - contract: mdbase.app-settings
    version: 1.0.0
    fields:
      app: app
      scope: scope
      settings_version: settings_version
  - contract: tasknotes.settings
    version: 1.0.0
    fields:
      app: app
      scope: scope
      settings_version: settings_version
      nlp_triggers: nlp_triggers
      template_enabled: template_enabled
      template_path: template_path
      occurrence_template_enabled: occurrence_template_enabled
      occurrence_template_path: occurrence_template_path
      template_failure_mode: template_failure_mode
      template_unknown_variable_policy: template_unknown_variable_policy
      move_on_archive: move_on_archive
      archive_folder: archive_folder
      auto_stop_time_tracking_on_complete: auto_stop_time_tracking_on_complete
      reset_body_checkboxes_on_recurrence: reset_body_checkboxes_on_recurrence
      link_write_format: link_write_format
      status_behavior: status_behavior
---

# TaskNotes settings

Settings that every TaskNotes client honours in this collection, such as body
templates, archive moves and status cycling. TaskNotes reads them from
`_settings/dev.tasknotes.md` and writes only the fields a save changes.
